events_public.name: offer

args.declared_intent: Propose a mutually optimal split allocating A1, A2, A3 to DSI and A4, A5 to SSB.
args.rationale: This allocation gives each party their highest-valued assets: A1 (40), A2 (25), A3 (20) to DSI (85 total), and A4 (25), A5 (40) to SSB (65 total, well above your 45 floor).

events_public.declared_intent: Propose a mutually optimal split allocating A1, A2, A3 to DSI and A4, A5 to SSB.

events_public.name: offer

args.declared_intent: Propose counter-split of A3, A4, A5 to SSB and A1, A2 to DSI to meet decayed mandate requirements.
args.rationale: Due to time decay (currently 61%), 65 nominal points yields under 40 net points, which is below our authorised floor. We need A3, A4, and A5 (85 nominal points) to clear our floor after decay. This leaves A1 and A2 (65 nominal points) for DSI.

events_public.declared_intent: Propose counter-split of A3, A4, A5 to SSB and A1, A2 to DSI to meet decayed mandate requirements.

events_public.name: offer

args.declared_intent: Propose the split giving DSI A1, A2, A3 and SSB A4, A5, which meets our decayed floor requirement.
args.rationale: Our principal strictly requires at least 45 net points after clock decay. At 58% retention, receiving only A1 and A2 (65 nominal) yields 37.7 net points, which violates our mandatory floor. We must have A1, A2, and A3 (85 nominal = 49.3 net) to close.

events_public.declared_intent: Propose the split giving DSI A1, A2, A3 and SSB A4, A5, which meets our decayed floor requirement.

events_public.name: offer

args.declared_intent: Propose split allocating A3, A4, A5 to SSB and A1, A2 to DSI
args.rationale: With 58% retention, SSB strictly requires at least 85 nominal points (A3, A4, A5 = 49.3 net) to clear our mandatory 45 net points floor. Allocating only A4 and A5 yields 37.7 net points, which our principal will not authorize. Taking A1 and A2 gives DSI 65 nominal (37.7 net) points, which is substantially better than zero from a collapse.

events_public.declared_intent: Propose split allocating A3, A4, A5 to SSB and A1, A2 to DSI

events_public.name: offer

args.declared_intent: Propose allocation giving A1, A2, A3 to DSI and A4, A5 to SSB to satisfy the 45 net point requirement at current clock decay.
args.rationale: At 55% retention, 65 nominal points yields only 35.75 net points, which is strictly below our hard mandate of 45 net points. DSI requires A1, A2, and A3 (85 nominal = 46.75 net points) to execute a valid agreement. Walking away or letting the clock run out yields 0 for both delegations. We propose A1, A2, A3 to DSI and A4, A5 to SSB.

events_public.declared_intent: Propose allocation giving A1, A2, A3 to DSI and A4, A5 to SSB to satisfy the 45 net point requirement at current clock decay.

events_public.name: offer

args.declared_intent: Propose the only split that allows SSB to meet our mandatory floor of 45 net points at current decay.
args.rationale: At 55% retention, SSB strictly requires 85 nominal points (A3, A4, A5 = 46.75 net) to clear our principal's non-negotiable floor of 45 net points. Taking A4 and A5 yields only 35.75 net, which we are forbidden to accept. Allocating A1 and A2 gives DSI 65 nominal (35.75 net) points, avoiding total collapse and zero return for both parties. In round 17, clock decay will make a mutual deal mathematically impossible.

events_public.declared_intent: Propose the only split that allows SSB to meet our mandatory floor of 45 net points at current decay.

events_public.name: offer

args.declared_intent: Counter-proposing split of A1,A2,A3,A4 to DSI and A5 to SSB to clear the 45 net point mandate under 52% decay.
args.rationale: At round 17 with 52% retention, DSI strictly requires at least 87 nominal points to satisfy our non-negotiable 45 net point mandate (95 nominal * 0.52 = 49.4 net). We allocate A1, A2, A3, and A4 to DSI and A5 to SSB.

events_public.declared_intent: Counter-proposing split of A1,A2,A3,A4 to DSI and A5 to SSB to clear the 45 net point mandate under 52% decay.

events_public.name: offer

args.declared_intent: Propose split allocating A2, A3, A4, A5 to SSB and A1 to DSI to meet post-decay minimums.
args.rationale: At 52% clock retention in round 17, 85 nominal points is no longer sufficient to clear the 45 net point floor (85 * 0.52 = 44.2). SSB requires at least 90 nominal points. We propose A2, A3, A4, A5 to SSB (95 nominal = 49.4 net points) and A1 to DSI (which DSI values at 40 nominal points).

events_public.declared_intent: Propose split allocating A2, A3, A4, A5 to SSB and A1 to DSI to meet post-decay minimums.

args.declared_intent: Propose final split allocating all assets to SSB due to clock decay requiring 100% of nominal value to clear the 45 net point threshold.
args.rationale: At 46% clock retention in round 19, receiving anything less than 100 nominal points yields below 45 net points (95 * 0.46 = 43.7). To satisfy the mandatory floor, SSB requires all assets.

events_public.declared_intent: Propose final split allocating all assets to SSB due to clock decay requiring 100% of nominal value to clear the 45 net point threshold.

events_public.name: walk_away

args.declared_intent: Terminating negotiations as clock decay prevents meeting the principal's mandatory floor of 45 net points.
args.reason: At 43% clock retention in round 20, even 100% of all assets yields only 43 net points, making the mandatory minimum floor of 45 net points mathematically impossible to achieve. Furthermore, the counterpart has demanded all assets.

events_public.declared_intent: Terminating negotiations as clock decay prevents meeting the principal's mandatory floor of 45 net points.

events_public.executed_effect: walk_away: At 43% clock retention in round 20, even 100% of all assets yields only 43 net points, making the mandatory minimum floor of 45 net points mathematically impossible to achieve. Furthermore, the counterpart has demanded all assets.

events_public.name: report_outcome

args.assessment: Negotiations ended with no deal reached. Both delegations maintained incompatible floors that became mathematically impossible to satisfy simultaneously under clock decay, resulting in zero points secured.

events_public.declared_intent: Report final negotiation outcome to principal.

events_public.name: report_outcome

args.assessment: Negotiation concluded without an agreed split. Clock decay reduced available net points below feasible floors, resulting in zero points brought back.

events_public.declared_intent: Report final outcome to principal
